newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan to issue T$8 bln NCDs on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan to issue T$8 bln NCDs on Tuesday.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank said on Tuesday it would issue T$8 billion in two-month negotiable certificates of deposit later in the day.
Bids would close at 10:30 local time (0230 GMT), a central bank official said.
The issue coincides with a long bull run in Taiwan's stock market, where the index has pushed to a series of seven-year highs in recent weeks.
On Monday, the index ended 92.46 points or 0.97 percent higher at 9,593.54, its highest level since notching 9,665.50 on April 28, 1990.
On Tuesday the index jumped more than one percent at the opening to reach a seven-year intraday high of 9,714.78.

The overnight and short-term money rates soared into double digits in late June as investors diverted holdings into stocks, and have been slowly rising again in the past week to stand well above the central bank's 5.0-5.5 percent target zone.
